assay_run.method: SMARTSeq v2 cDNA preparation from 1 ng total RNA with ERCC spike-in, followed by Nextera XT library preparation and paired-end sequencing. Platform follows sample-specific GEO/SRA registration; the article/extraction protocol instead reports HiSeq 2000 and 2 × 51 cycles, while GEO processing text reports 2 × 150 bp. Read length is unresolved.
